procurement_title: Hindi Annotation of Student Voice Recordings from Pilot of ORF Tool in Chhattisgarh (20 hrs)
scope_summary: 20 hours of Hindi student voice recordings; timestamp every heard word or letter verbatim without grammar/spelling correction; blind annotation; onboarding in December and work scheduled January-February 2027
explicit_requirements: Human annotators; timestamped verbatim transcript; shared protocol; mandatory onboarding; partner tool demonstration; QA/review alignment and readiness sign-off
capability_gaps: No demonstrated timestamped annotation workflow; no qualified annotation team or independent reviewer; no tool demonstration evidence; child voice data requires strict consent, access and retention controls
decision: Do not bid or contact unless eligibility, child-data safeguards, staffing, tooling and sample quality can all be evidenced; use as product-requirement research only

procurement_title: Multilingual Audio Annotation, Transcription and Translation Services across Indian Languages
scope_summary: Health-domain ASR annotation/transcription plus Indian-language-to-English and English-to-Indian-language translation; initial languages Hindi, Marathi and Odia; future language/volume additions under rate contract
explicit_requirements: Qualified native-speaker annotators/translators; healthcare terminology knowledge; independent human review; senior adjudication; multi-pass QA; rework rejected batches; purpose-built tool (spreadsheets not accepted); secure approved environment
capability_gaps: No evidenced multi-language team, clinical terminology reviewer, independent adjudication capacity, purpose-built annotation tool, secure approved processing environment, vendor quality references or demonstrated rate-contract operations
decision: Do not bid or contact unless every staffing, quality, security, tool and vendor-document requirement is met; strongest product discovery signal for a future annotation QA workbench

procurement_title: Stratified Audio Data Collection for Custom ASR Model in Telemedicine Platform
scope_summary: Collect high-quality Hindi and English voice recordings from Community Health Officers and Medical Officers for ASR training/testing; cover urban, rural and tribal settings and demographic, professional, dialect and fluency variation
explicit_requirements: Field access to healthcare workers; representative stratified sampling; consent and privacy controls; clinical-context audio collection; dataset quality and documentation
capability_gaps: No demonstrated field-research network, healthcare institutional access, consent/data-governance process, audio collection operations or ASR dataset delivery references
decision: Do not bid; beyond current SRI capability and deadline; retain as evidence of recurring demand for Indian-accent clinical speech data
